source: Art. 15: right of authorship, right to be named, right of disclosure, right of integrity; independent of economic rights (15(3)); not transferable by succession, heirs may assert without time limit (art. 29)
text: Art. 15 : droit à la paternité, droit d'être nommé, droit de divulgation, droit au respect de l'intégrité ; indépendant des droits patrimoniaux (15(3)) ; non transmissible par succession, les héritiers peuvent l'invoquer sans limite de temps (art. 29)

source: Art. 181(5) bans making/importing devices to circumvent technical protection (e.g. encryption); 181(6) bans bad-faith removal/disabling; no explicit RMI rule found

source: Art. 27 allows reproducing works permanently in public places, unless the image is the main subject and used commercially

source: Art. 3(14) defines technical protection measures; Art. 88 prohibits their violation/circumvention; RMI provision not confirmed

source: Art. 34: private copies, short quotations with credit, parody, teaching examples; Arts. 35-38 add programs, libraries, public artworks, broadcasts; Art. 88 extends them to folklore

source: Art. 39: where the author is not named or identity is not beyond doubt, copyright lasts 50 years from 1 January after first publication
text: Art. 39 : lorsque l'auteur n'est pas nommé ou que son identité n'est pas certaine, le droit d'auteur dure 50 ans à compter du 1er janvier suivant la première publication

source: Art. 4 defines TPM and RMI; circumvention, related services and unauthorised removal/alteration of RMI are infringements (article no. unverified) (unconfirmed)

source: Art. 4(s)-(t) define technological measures, circumvention and rights management information; Art. 58(3)(b)-(f) make altering RMI, circumvention, and making or selling circumvention devices or services infringements

source: Art. 47: unlawful to make/import devices defeating copy-protection or decoding encrypted broadcasts, and to remove/alter electronic rights-management data
text: Art. 47 : il est illicite de fabriquer/importer des dispositifs neutralisant la protection contre la copie ou décodant des émissions cryptées, et de supprimer/altérer des données électroniques sur la gestion des droits

source: Art. 48: Minister may grant a non-exclusive licence to copy or translate for public, educational or research needs if the owner refused or cannot be found after reasonable effort; fair pay to owner

source: Art. 53: TPMs defined; breaking/deactivating TPMs is infringement; 53.2 bans making/importing/supplying circumvention tools; RMI provision not confirmed
